scope: Read-only static review of exact files and installed Lean 4.35 source; pure-Python acceptance/parser checks only. No Lean execution, Linux runtime execution, Git push, workflow dispatch, or external action.
reviewer_independence: Reviewer did not author the private workflow or verification wrapper; reviewer previously edited reader documentation and underlying mathematical proofs.

controls.mandatory_acceptance: Comparator exit zero AND all three fixed success strings. Official 4.35 code runs all configured kernels and built-in Lean, then throws on any rejection before printing final success.
controls.positive: Same exported True theorem must pass mandatory Comparator, Lean and NanoDa.
controls.statement_negative: True versus True-and-True must fail with the actual statement mismatch diagnostic.
controls.axiom_negative: Proof using a custom axiom must fail with the actual illegal-axiom diagnostic.
controls.kernel_negative: Target proof field replaced with its type expression must be rejected by BOTH NanoDa and Lean; target type remains unchanged.
controls.advisory_controls: Pinned con-ron must accept the good export and reject the ill-typed export before candidate verification.
controls.advisory_policy: Official pinned con_ron_outcome parser; rejection/unknown error blocks; positively recognized support/fuel decline or supervisor timeout after mandatory acceptance may decline without adding con-ron to successful kernels.

workflow_checks.candidate_build_and_exports: Separate network-disabled Bubblewrap processes; candidate source and tools read-only, only candidate .lake writable during build.
workflow_checks.judge_boundary: Official lake comparator invoked using protected export files and configuration; candidate source/olean files are not mounted into the judge.
workflow_checks.source_integrity: Before/after source snapshot plus tracked, staged and untracked Git checks. Export hashes checked unchanged after mandatory and advisory replay.
workflow_checks.commit_binding: Exact github.sha checkout, report source commit equality required, artifact named by commit and run attempt.
workflow_checks.failure_behavior: Bootstrap, controls, mandatory checks, source integrity, final report status and artifact-upload failures produce unsuccessful workflow; no continue-on-error.
workflow_checks.secrets: No repository credentials persisted by checkout, no secret input to the verifier, cleared sandbox environment; bootstrap is the explicit network-enabled phase.
workflow_checks.advisory_separation: Only Lean/NanoDa mandatory success can establish mandatory_status passed; con-ron separately recorded.
workflow_checks.publication: No visibility change, registry submission or intake command.

documentation: README and metadata distinguish completed local build/ABI/kernel/raw-closure checks from hosted per-commit reports and unrun official full preflight. Zero implementation holes explicitly excludes three authorized Challenge holes. Current metadata targets/axioms and source inventory agree with configuration.

resolved_findings.finding: Final reporting step could write not_verified without independently failing its step; prior failed steps normally already failed the job.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added if not passed: raise SystemExit(1) after writing report and summary. Verified in final reviewed workflow.

limits: No hosted/Linux execution performed in this review; nested namespaces, resource use and exact checker outcomes must be established by the actual private run.
Positive/negative controls establish correct behavior on their fixtures; they are not a proof of checker correctness.
Private standalone verification is not official Palomar full mechanical preflight.
